verdict.rationale: vLLM's first-party docs list prefix caching as a core feature alongside continuous batching and chunked prefill. It is built on PagedAttention KV-cache management, and community users describe KV caching as one of vLLM's most impactful performance features. The evidence, though, is a single feature-list line rather than in-depth documentation. Missing for 10: a dedicated prefix-caching doc page showing how to enable or configure it, measured speedups on repeated-prompt workloads, and independent hands-on corroboration specific to prefix caching.
